summary.request: Customers need a default Delivery Window code. New customers are created from customer templates or from contacts, and the code should come from the template. Sales quotes take the code from the customer, and when a quote or blanket order becomes an order the order must keep the code the quote or blanket order had, even if it was changed by hand.
summary.business-process: Add a customer default Delivery Window code, filled from customer templates (including customers created from contacts), defaulted onto sales quotes from the sell-to customer, and kept unchanged when Sales-Quote to Order or Blanket Sales Order to Order creates the order; this changes customer creation and the sales document process of the base application.

objects.purpose: Holds the customer's default Delivery Window code, the source of the sales document default.

Event subscribers: copy the sell-to customer's Delivery Window to the sales header, and restore the archived value after an archive restore revalidates the customer. Contains no OnAfterInitRecord default, so conversion never overwrites the value carried from the quote or blanket order.

data-flow.to: Customer."Delivery Window" (customer created from a template)
data-flow.note: Customer Templ. Mgt. ApplyTemplate copies by RecordRef, field by field, without Validate, only into an empty customer field. No subscriber; requires the mirrored template field.

data-flow.to: Customer."Delivery Window" (customer created from a contact)
data-flow.note: Contact inserts the customer, then calls ApplyCustomerTemplate; same RecordRef copy as the template path.

data-flow.to: Sales Header."Delivery Window" (quote, and every other document type when Sell-to Customer No. is validated)
data-flow.note: Plain assignment in OnAfterCopySellToCustomerAddressFieldsFromCustomer; delivery data follows the sell-to party.

data-flow.to: Sales Header (order) via Sales-Quote to Order
data-flow.note: Record assignment of the quote header; Insert(true) then runs InitRecord, so no subscriber may default the field there. A hand-changed value survives.

data-flow.to: Sales Header (order) via Blanket Sales Order to Order
data-flow.note: Record assignment of the blanket header; same InitRecord rule. Header field, so OnAfterResetQuantityFields does not apply.
ArchiveManagement, including the optional archive of the quote during conversion.
TransferFields back, then customer revalidation overwrites the value; OnAfterTransferFromArchToSalesHeader reassigns the archived value.

data-flow.to: Sales Shipment Header, Sales Invoice Header, Sales Cr.Memo Header, Return Receipt Header

subscriptions.purpose: Copy SellToCustomer."Delivery Window" to the sales header with a plain assignment when the sell-to customer is validated.
guards: Assign from the SellToCustomer record the event passes; no page-level default
Do not default in OnAfterInitRecord; if a fallback default is ever added there, set it only when the field is empty so converted orders keep the source value

subscriptions.purpose: Reassign SalesHeaderArchive."Delivery Window" after restore revalidated the sell-to customer and replaced it with the current customer default.
guards: Assign only; no Modify (the record is modified right after the event)

lifecycle.step: Set DataClassification = CustomerContent on the Delivery Window field in every table extension (tableextensions cannot inherit a table-level value).

No InitValue is designed, so no upgrade code is required for new rows. Existing customers, templates and open documents stay blank after installation; back-filling them needs upgrade code guarded by an upgrade tag (open question existing-data).

tests.given: A Customer Templ. with Delivery Window set
tests.when: A customer is created from that template through Customer Templ. Mgt.
tests.then: The new customer's Delivery Window equals the template value

tests.given: A company contact and a Customer Templ. with Delivery Window set
tests.when: A customer is created from the contact with that template
tests.then: The new customer's Delivery Window equals the template value

tests.given: A customer (LibrarySales.CreateCustomer) with Delivery Window set
tests.when: A sales quote is created and Sell-to Customer No. is validated
tests.then: The quote header's Delivery Window equals the customer's

tests.given: A quote whose Delivery Window was changed by hand to a value different from the customer's
tests.then: The created order's Delivery Window equals the quote's hand-changed value, not the customer default

tests.given: A blanket sales order whose Delivery Window was changed by hand
tests.when: Blanket Sales Order to Order runs
tests.then: The created order's Delivery Window equals the blanket order's value

tests.given: A sales order with Delivery Window set, and a return order with Delivery Window set
tests.when: They are posted (ship and invoice; receive and credit memo)
tests.then: Sales Shipment Header, Sales Invoice Header, Return Receipt Header and Sales Cr.Memo Header each hold the same value

tests.given: A quote archived with Delivery Window A, after which the customer's Delivery Window is changed to B
tests.then: Sales Header Archive held A and the restored quote holds A, not B

open-questions.question: Does a Delivery Window table (code list) already exist, and in which app? If not, should one be created as a new Supplemental code table with its own page and permissions? Its key field type and length fix the length of every Delivery Window field.

Should the Delivery Window also reach Sales Header Archive and the posted shipment, invoice, credit memo and return receipt headers? The design mirrors it on all of them as the mirroring article requires; any can be excluded.

The sell-to event defaults the code on every sales document type (orders, blanket orders, invoices, credit memos, return orders), not only quotes. Is that wanted, or should the default be restricted to quotes and blanket orders?
When the template has no Delivery Window, should new customers get a fallback value, or stay blank? A fallback belongs in OnApplyTemplateOnBeforeCustomerModify only when the field is empty.

Copy Document copies posted and archived headers back into Sales Header with TransferFields. Should the copied document keep the source's Delivery Window, or take it from the customer (requiring a clear in OnAfterCopySalesHeaderDone)?
Should existing customers, customer templates and open quotes, blanket orders and orders be back-filled with a Delivery Window on installation, and from what value?
Should the Delivery Window be shown on posted document pages, archive pages or reports?
